name: Domain-Adapted Project and Generation Orchestration
description: A source-backed parent view of domain discovery, evidence collection, prompt construction, parallel generation, validation, and persistence.

codeEntities.label: discoverDomainCorpus
codeEntities.summary: Selects repository or document corpus discovery from the requested built-in domain profile.

codeEntities.label: DiagramApplication.createDiagramSet
codeEntities.summary: Validates a creation target, ensures its project, and initializes a generated DiagramSet.

codeEntities.label: DiagramStore.ensureProject
codeEntities.summary: Loads or creates the persisted ProjectRecord while enforcing corpus identity and domain ownership.

codeEntities.label: resolveDomainProfile
codeEntities.summary: Resolves persisted or legacy domain metadata to one of the built-in runtime profiles.

codeEntities.label: DiagramSetRecord
codeEntities.summary: Aggregates the evidence collection, artifacts, generation batches, runs, readiness, and creation provenance for one set.

codeEntities.label: CodeEntitiesSetRecord
codeEntities.summary: Owns the revisioned CodeEntity collection and its collecting, finalized, or failed lifecycle state.

codeEntities.label: createCodeEntityPromptConfig
codeEntities.summary: Renders identification, compaction, and context prompts into an immutable collection prompt configuration.

codeEntities.label: DiagramAgentRuntime.collectEntities
codeEntities.summary: Defines the runtime boundary that collects source-backed CodeEntity drafts from an agent session.

codeEntities.label: DiagramApplication.validateEntityDrafts
codeEntities.summary: Checks entity metadata and source ranges, snapshots corpus lines, and creates persisted CodeEntity records.

codeEntities.label: createGenerationPromptConfig
codeEntities.summary: Resolves selected evidence and references into a revision-pinned, domain-adapted generation prompt configuration.

codeEntities.label: GenerationBatchRecord
codeEntities.summary: Tracks one parallel generation request, its child runs, evidence revision, output artifacts, and completion state.

codeEntities.label: AgentRunRecord
codeEntities.summary: Records the status, model session, parallel slot, and output identity of one agent operation.

codeEntities.label: DiagramAgentRuntime.generateArtifact
codeEntities.summary: Defines the runtime boundary that generates and maps one ASCII artifact for a parallel batch slot.

codeEntities.label: DiagramCodeEntityMapRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists revision-bound spatial mappings from an artifact's ASCII coordinates to its CodeEntity evidence.

codeEntities.label: DiagramStore.completeBatch
codeEntities.summary: Commits validated artifacts, mappings, runs, and candidate-batch state, then attaches outputs to the DiagramSet.
